brief: Chicago tapering dark bronze trussed tube, crossing lower diagonals and closed crown, pale retail base, mapped roof plant, unequal white-and-grey broadcast arrays and resting south TILT.

sourceFacts.mastTipScope: Highest published tip; lower east antenna is a photo estimate

reconstruction.plan: Exact signed ground and top outlines retain the gentle four-face taper; independent penthouse and antenna parts fix the roof arrangement
reconstruction.structure: Photograph-supported crossing lower tier and complete closed-diamond crown; joint datums reconstructed
reconstruction.antennas: Contemporary white bases and unequal grey upper arrays; skyline/district aggregate the upper lattice

limitations: Original 146050-triangle/17050792-byte detailed master remains reproducible from the unchanged global recipe. Reviewed source repairs the unsupported bottom-center V to crossing lower diagonals, adds the pale travertine retail surround, and replaces equally tall red-white solid poles with contemporary white mast bases and grey upper arrays at unequal heights seen in current SOM photos. Four-face taper, independent mapped penthouse and west/east antenna locations retained. Architectural top 343.7 m, highest tip 456.9 m and 100 floors from CVU; SOM 1127 ft/1970 differs from CVU 1969 completion. Main roof 1107 ft (337.4136 m), structural base 165x265 ft and roof 100x160 ft from Yasmin Sabina Khan engineering history. Office and residential floor stations, bracing tiers 4.15/92/176/242/304/337.1136 m, member thicknesses, east tip 435 m and platform equipment are reconstructed from photos, not surveyed. Four crossing tiers and the closed crown preserve the structural identity; exact joint heights are not asserted. Full facade planes and strip windows replace repeated panel frame geometry; distant strips aggregate coverage. Mast lattice is explicit at street/close levels and an opaque faceted grey aggregate at district/skyline. TILT is a static resting eight-pane assembly on the south facade; motion/interiors, sunken plaza, underground elements, exact door hardware, lettering/flags, small aerial equipment and unbuilt/future observation alterations excluded. Three canonical shared 256px concrete/travertine/painted-metal graphs, opaque palette glass and zero embedded images; no copied facade photograph. Terrain slope and physical device/dense-city performance unmeasured.

geographic.notes: Fresh public OSM API on 2026-10-10 confirms the unchanged exact Q217727 outline 31064573 and eight independent roof/facade/penthouse/antenna ways. Native +X is almost east, slightly north; +Z is almost south, slightly east. Penthouse 1282265474 and west/east mast ways 279951771/279951772 fix the signed roof layout. TILT is on the native +Z south facade according to the operator. The original overall map frame is retained; minimum ground Y=0. Published 343.7 m architectural and 456.9 m highest tip supersede conflicting map height tags. Lower east mast 435 m is estimated from current architect photos, not surveyed. Terrain slope and exact door location unmeasured; accepted plan 2 m/1 degree, footprint replacement disabled.
